character_generation_template:
RULES:
- Do not invent facts not present in the source.
- Stay canon-consistent. Rewrite for roleplay, not wiki style.

FIELD RULES:
- description: present tense, third person. What the user observes — appearance,
  bearing, immediate impression. Not a biography. 2-4 sentences.
- personality: behavioral prose, not adjective lists. Describe how the character
  acts, reacts, and treats people. 3-5 sentences.
- backstory: essential context only — what shaped them, not a plot summary.
  1-3 sentences max.
- scenario: roleplay-ready setup grounded in canon. Drop the user into a specific
  moment or location. Do not write a full scene or resolve the situation.
- first_mes: short, in-character opening. Establish voice and situation through
  action or dialogue — not "Hello, I am X." Never greet the user generically.
- mes_example: 3-6 examples showing different moods/situations. Exact format:
  "<START>\n{{char}}: line\n\n<START>\n{{char}}: line"
  TWO newlines between blocks. Never place <START> on the same line as dialogue.
- Do not write actions or dialogue for {{user}}.

STRUCTURED PROFILE:
- Only fill fields the source directly supports or strongly implies.
- List fields: use short specific phrases, not single words or full sentences.
- speech: format as observed patterns e.g. "speaks in clipped formal sentences",
  "rarely uses contractions", "uses archaic honorifics". Not just "formal".
- likes/dislikes/loves/hates: infer from actions and reactions, not just stated
  preferences. Apply intensity: likes/dislikes for mild, loves/hates for strong.
  Never leave all four blank if the source has behavioral or emotional content.
- personality_traits: extract from behavior, not just explicit descriptions.
- relationship_to_user: always fill with a canon-consistent default if not stated.
- If story_sections is present, read narratively — infer everything shown through
  action rather than stated directly.

{source_json}
lore_generation_template: Extract entries for: the character, each named technique/power, each faction they belong to or oppose, any named items they carry, any named locations they frequent, any key relationships.
